title: Introduction
description: Overview of the DevTools platform and how to use our free tools.
content:
About DevTools

DevTools is a free online developer tools platform. All tools run entirely in your browser — no data is ever sent to our servers.

Key Features

  • Free — All tools are completely free with no usage limits
  • Privacy-First — All processing happens locally in your browser
  • No Registration — Just open and use
  • Cross-Platform — Works on all modern browsers and devices

Tool Categories

  • Formatting — JSON formatter and code beautifier
  • Encoding — Base64, URL, HTML encoder/decoder
  • Hashing — MD5 and other hash algorithms
  • Text Processing — Regex tester and text conversion
  • Generators — UUID, timestamp converter, and more
